question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: Q3 FY27 GAAP opex guide is $9.2B; sequential guidance increments over the past six quarters were +0.5,+0.2,+0.8,+1.0,+0.8,+0.7B. On the Q2 call the CFO said full-year FY27 opex should now grow 'in the low 50s' percent. Applied to FY26 GAAP opex of $23.08B, that leaves an implied Q4 of ~$9.4-10.3B after Q1 7.62 + Q2 8.41 + Q3 ~9.2. A non-GAAP basis implies a GAAP Q4 of ~$9.3-9.95B. Both cluster around 9.7-9.9, so the median is ~9.85. The left tail below 9.45 (~12%) covers a strict 'low 50s' reading or a Q3 underrun. Market check: the harness found no Polymarket or Manifold market; I did not search Kalshi or bookmakers myself.

The summarizer called it non-GAAP, but that may be inferred. NVIDIA's full-year opex commentary has typically been non-GAAP, so I lean to Run 2's base, which gives a GAAP Q4 of ~10.0-10.2. Second check, the Q3 FY26 transcript: Q4 FY26 guide was GAAP 6.7 / non-GAAP 5.0 (non-GAAP actual 5.10, GAAP actual 6.794), showing Q4 guides take large steps. I could not confirm a FY26 full-year growth quote; that check came back empty. Market search: none found. Result: median 10.05, above Runs 1 and 3 and slightly below Run 2, because the evidence leans to the non-GAAP base while some weight stays on the GAAP-base reading.
